lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kell, 2064. The retreat has terraces now, and solar sails, and a water system somebody clever built out of scrap.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: About forty people live here. None of them appear in a census, which in this century is the entire point.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Oh. Oh, they kept the orchard.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: Two centuries and four hundred metres from where I was standing this morning. I am not equal to it.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Off-grid, unregistered and upslope of everything. My lot didn't invent that. We inherited it.
